in_marathi.name: Dhananjoy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wealth, Prosperity, Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhananjoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhananjoy is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘dhan’ meaning wealth or prosperity, and ‘anand’ meaning joy. The name is believed to bring happiness and prosperity to the one who bears it. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the god Dhanvantari, who is the preserver of Ayurvedic medicine and the giver of health and wealth.
